26 matches (all) | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2003–04 Egyptian Premier League|2003–04]] | nextseason = [[2005–06 Egyptian Premier League|2005–06]] }} In the '''2004–05 Egyptian Premier League''', 14 teams participated. The first-placed team was the champion, and qualified to the [[CAF Champions League]] 2006 along with the team finishing in second place. The third-placed team qualified to the [[CAF Confederation Cup]]. Finally, the bottom three in the league are relegated to play the next season in the second division. Each team played 26 matches from September 2004 to April 2005. [[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]] were crowned champions by a 31-point margin and did not lose a game during the campaign (only dropping four points via two draws), a feat they repeated the following season.
